nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
# Qwen Image 2.1

Drop an image on Canvas, enter an edit instruction, Queue, then accept the result. References are wired to both conditioning paths.

Baseline: 25 steps, Euler / simple, CFG 1. Negative prompts have no effect at CFG 1. Start near 1 MP. CFG 2 can improve dense text instructions but may sharpen edges; compare with the same seed before keeping it.

https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/image/qwen/qwen-image-2-1

### Checked recipe
Qwen 2.1: 25 steps, CFG 1, euler / simple. Sampler profile checks model and latent compatibility. Profiles do not select weights: Base, Turbo, Distilled and Edit checkpoints are not interchangeable. Use a fixed seed when comparing changes; increase size only after the prompt and composition work. Negative text has no sampling effect at CFG 1.
